cases.title: Drag-selection from dead space and text
cases.description: Verify that text drag-selection functions correctly when initiated from both empty whitespace (dead space) and directly from within text characters.

cases.title: Double-click text highlighting
cases.description: Verify that performing a double-click gesture on a target word highlights the word correctly while properly handling adjacent punctuation.

cases.title: Shift-select text range
cases.description: Verify that text can be successfully selected by establishing an initial anchor point and performing a Shift-click gesture at an end point.

cases.title: Drag-scrolling during text selection
cases.description: Verify that dragging a text selection beyond the viewport boundaries triggers auto-scrolling while maintaining the active selection state.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly address the requirements without any blockers.
All test cases are well-defined, properly mapped to their respective requirements, and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-140: Testable behavior includes initiating a drag-selection starting from empty whitespace (dead space) and from existing text characters. Boundaries include boundary lines of paragraphs and container edges. Normal path: text highlights following the cursor. Abnormal path: drag starts on non-selectable elements. Ambiguities: definition of 'dead space' within various layout contexts. R-141: Testable behavior is double-clicking a word to highlight it. Boundaries include punctuation marks attached to words. Normal path: word is highlighted. Abnormal path: clicking whitespace or non-text elements. Ambiguities: handling of hyphenated words. R-142: Testable behavior is clicking a start point and Shift-clicking an end point to select the intervening text. Boundaries include document start and end. Normal path: range between clicks is selected. Abnormal path: Shift-click without an initial anchor point. Ambiguities: cross-element shift selections. R-143: Testable behavior is dragging text selection beyond the viewport to trigger auto-scrolling. Boundaries include document top and bottom limits. Normal path: page scrolls while maintaining the active selection. Abnormal path: rapid dragging causing scroll jitter. Ambiguities: auto-scroll speed and acceleration behavior.
